issues.title: Narration timing must come from LLM, not calculated from TTS
Manim only renders FIRST visual beat - multi-beat rendering not implemented
Recap narration only 5 seconds - LLM not generating full recap narration
issues.root_cause: 1) TTS used section-level narration instead of combining recap_scenes[].narration. 2) Prompt too long (~8k tokens) - critical rules buried deep. 3) Examples showed short narrations despite 60-100 word requirement.
issues.solution: 1) tts/generate_audio.py: combines recap_scenes[].narration for TTS. 2) Added CRITICAL COMPLIANCE CHECKLIST at TOP of both prompts. 3) Added word_count field requirement in each recap_scene. 4) Updated examples with word_count fields.
